description: Add 1 to 32 notes with the write token. Each note is an object with text, 1 to 2000 characters, and an optional key of up to 64 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens. Notes are stored until the collection expires and count toward its 500-note lifetime limit, deleted notes included. Never send secrets or sensitive personal data. Adding and searching share a usage limit of 60 per minute and 1000 per UTC day per IP. Refusals may carry Retry-After. Do not retry automatically. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

write_token.description: The write_token from create_semantic_search, shown once. It adds and deletes notes.

name: add_semantic_search_notes
title: Add notes to a semantic search collection
